title: Identifying the Location of an Accessory Pathway in Pre-Excitation Syndromes Using an Artificial Intelligence-Based Algorithm
summary: A neural network used 12-lead ECG delta-wave polarity to identify accessory-pathway location against successful ablation site in 357 retrospective WPW patients. It was compared with three conventional ECG algorithms and had higher reported accuracy; the single-center retrospective evaluation does not establish prospective benefit.
ai_technology: Backpropagation neural network trained on 12-lead ECG-derived delta-wave polarity; ablation site was reference. 70/30 patient-level train/internal-validation split; accuracy 85.7% across 14 locations, versus lower accuracy at lower resolution for three conventional algorithms.
